house.description: Minnesota FFA funding provided for new and expanded access for members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance
Authors added Lillie, Gander, and Knudsen

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money to Minnesota FFA to provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA FFA. +]

[+(a) $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota FFA to provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities. Of this amount: +]

[+(1) up to $125,000 each year may be used to document and commemorate 100 years of fostering leadership, agricultural education, and community service across the state by creating a history book, video storytelling series, and an in-person arts-focused event; and +]

[+(2) any amount not spent for the purposes described in clause (1) may be used for other activities that provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities, including activities related to national and state FFA band and choir, state and national FFA talent competitions, FFA floriculture, and FFA state fair landscape booths. +]

[+(b) The commissioner of agriculture must develop grant-making criteria and guidance for grants under this section to provide funding for projects and events and must seek input from the Minnesota FFA and Minnesota FFA Foundation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money to Minnesota FFA to provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA FFA.

(a) $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota FFA to provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities. Of this amount:

(1) up to $125,000 each year may be used to document and commemorate 100 years of fostering leadership, agricultural education, and community service across the state by creating a history book, video storytelling series, and an in-person arts-focused event; and

(2) any amount not spent for the purposes described in clause (1) may be used for other activities that provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities, including activities related to national and state FFA band and choir, state and national FFA talent competitions, FFA floriculture, and FFA state fair landscape booths.

(b) The commissioner of agriculture must develop grant-making criteria and guidance for grants under this section to provide funding for projects and events and must seek input from the Minnesota FFA and Minnesota FFA Foundation.
additions: (a) $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of agriculture for grants to the Minnesota FFA to provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities. Of this amount:

(1) up to $125,000 each year may be used to document and commemorate 100 years of fostering leadership, agricultural education, and community service across the state by creating a history book, video storytelling series, and an in-person arts-focused event; and

(2) any amount not spent for the purposes described in clause (1) may be used for other activities that provide new and expanded access for Minnesota FFA members involved in art- and history-related FFA activities, including activities related to national and state FFA band and choir, state and national FFA talent competitions, FFA floriculture, and FFA state fair landscape booths.

(b) The commissioner of agriculture must develop grant-making criteria and guidance for grants under this section to provide funding for projects and events and must seek input from the Minnesota FFA and Minnesota FFA Foundation.
